note: A numbers-clarity release, and the fixes an install test of 2026.08.21 turned up. The trade console shows ONE price and it is the quote: the protection floor is no longer rendered as an amount anywhere, because two currency figures in the same register is what let a guaranteed minimum be read as an expected payout. The protection is stated in full as the slippage tolerance, where it is also adjustable, and it now says what it does. A measured cost-vs-NAV row answers the question behind the misread: what this fill or exit actually costs against the mark, at this size. Also: the MCP quickstart now names the install step it needed, the bundler says what is missing instead of throwing a module stack, the Bankr skill and the generated tool manifests carry the right version, and the MCP suite joined the release gate that would have caught them.
